first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence links shorter onboarding and fewer signup fields to improved time-to-value and SMB activation. A guarded simplification test is more likely to improve sustainable value than immediately matching competitor pricing, while qualified revenue should be monitored to ensure higher activation does not reduce lead quality.

final.rationale: Run a small, guarded onboarding simplification test focused on SMB self-serve accounts. Shortened onboarding improved completion, time-to-value, and 30-day retention, while signup simplification improved activation and qualified revenue but slightly reduced retention. Measure completion, activation, time-to-value, qualified revenue, and 30-day retention, with a rollback threshold for retention or revenue deterioration. Limit the test to the segment where the evidence holds and avoid broad pricing changes this week.
